Activate Grimgrin's ability from Karametra's Favor by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.

Resolve the Reluctant Role Model trigger, putting a coin counter onto itself as well as +1/+1 counters if those were present.
Resolve the Athreos trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability from step 1.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Reluctant Role Model.
When Reluctant Role Model dies, it and Athreos's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Reluctant Role Model trigger, putting a coin counter and +1/+1 counters onto the other nontoken creature.
Resolve the Athreos trigger, returning Reluctant Role Model from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability from step 6.
Repeat.

1479-5700-5701-6763-7892.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.

Play Petrified Field.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree and Thranduil the Strategist trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Echoing Deeps from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Thranduil the Strategist trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Echoing Deeps from your hand onto the battlefield untapped as a copy of Petrified Field.
When Echoing Deeps enters the battlefield, Thranduil the Strategist triggers.
Holding priority, activate Echoing Deeps using Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Petrified Field from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Thranduil the Strategist trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Petrified Field from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Thranduil the Strategist triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

Resolve Kor Skyfisher. When it enters, it and Answered Prayers trigger.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Answered Prayers trigger, causing you to gain life.
